input.justification: The tainted value (param, derived from the request query string) is stored in map47458 under key "keyB-47458", but immediately afterward `bar` is reassigned from map47458.get("keyA-47458"), which maps to the constant string "a_Value" put in earlier. Thus by the time `bar` is used to build the XPath expression `"/Employees/Employee[@emplid='" + bar + "']"`, it no longer carries the user-controlled value - it's the hardcoded "a_Value". The dataflow from user input to the XPath sink is broken by this reassignment, so the expression does not actually depend on user input despite CodeQL's taint tracking flagging it.
